name: Kirakishou
source:
Artificial Spirit: Rosary (ロザリオ)

The true seventh Rozen Maiden doll. Kirakishou's right eye is missing, she has a rose growing out of the empty eye socket, as described by Shinku: "Her left eye can see everything, but reflects nothing, while her right eye is an empty hole, with a white rose growing out of it." 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Rozen_Maiden_characters#Kirakishou]Wikipedia[/url].]
